1.w: For the one directing. A Psalm of David. I have waited patiently [for], YHWH! And He inclined to me and heard my cry.

2.w: And He brought me up from the pit of desolation, from the mud of the mire; and He raised up my feet upon a rock, [and] has made firm my steps.

3.w: And He put in my mouth a new song—praise to our God. Many will see [it] and will fear, and they will trust in YHWH.

4.w: Blessed [is] the man who makes YHWH his refuge, and does not turn toward the proud, and those turning aside to falsehood!

5.w: Much You have done, O YHWH my God, and wonderful are your thoughts toward us—none can compare to You! Were I to declare and speak, they are vast beyond numbering.

6.w: In sacrifice and offering You did not take delight, You have opened the ears for me; burnt offering and sin offering You did not require.

7.w: Then I said, “Behold, I have come—in the roll of the book it is written of me.

8.w: I have delighted to do Your will, O my God, and Your law [is] in the midst of my heart.”

9.w: I have proclaimed tidings of righteousness in the great assembly; behold, I do not restrain my lips, O YHWH, You have known.

10.w: Your righteousness I have not kept hidden in the midst of my heart; Your faithfulness and Your salvation I have declared; I have not concealed Your loving devotion and Your truth from the great assembly.

11.w: You, O YHWH, do not withhold Your mercies from me; may Your loving devotion and Your truth continually guard me.

12.w: For evils have surrounded against me, until there is no numbering [them]; my iniquities have overtaken me, and I am not able to see; they are vast [beyond] the hairs of my head, and my heart has left me.

13.w: Take pleasure, O YHWH, to deliver me! O YHWH, may You hurry to help me!

14.w: Let them be put to shame and confounded together, those seeking my soul, to snatch it away! Let them be driven back and humiliated, those delighting in my harm!

15.w: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame, those saying to me, “Aha, aha!”

16.w: All those seeking You, may they rejoice and be glad in You; let those loving Your salvation say continually, “YHWH be magnified!”

17.w: And I [am] poor and needy; may the Lord think of me; You [are] my help and my deliverer—O my God, do not delay!
